column2: Crap, you saw me...
H-Hey... do you like sweets...?
If you want... eat this for me.
Huff... huff... huff...
Listen... don't you ever go get $$薬$$ on your own!
...Thanks.
...For your sake too... get better soon.
Huff... huff... It hurts, but... I'm glad you're safe...
Huff... huff...
I-It's nothing...
Spring $$野菜$$ are damn good, huh!!
Cabbage stuffed with sausage, ground meat, and tomatoes, then boiled in a pot, is pretty damn good!!
Spring brings lots of food around, and that makes me happy...!
...Don't you think so too...?
Let's see...
In summer, new soba with eel omelet or pike conger dressed in plum...
Something light but filling would be good!
I've been getting summer fatigue lately, so maybe eel or yams sometimes...
Maybe I oughta eat stuff that gives me stamina...?
For fall, you've gotta grill up some saury, nice and quick!
And eat it with grated daikon, nice and easy, right!?
Fall's when they say you get an appetite, right...!
I always end up eating too much... Maybe I'm getting happy-fat!
Daikon's good in winter, huh!?
Yeah, you really know your stuff. Huh!? You're making something?!
Well, I'm looking forward to it...!
Whew... it's cold today! When it's this chilly, don't you want to share a hot pot together!?
Sure... lettuce is good right now too!
But watch out for green caterpillars, okay!?
I went to the field yesterday, and the tomatoes were bright red...
Oh, you picked them already. Thanks.
What's this... $$ジャガイモ$$!?
Then let's make roasted sweet potatoes together and eat them with butter!?
Leeks and turnips are in season now...!
Eating what's in season is best for your body, you know...!
What's wrong...?
Don't tell me... you're feeling sick again?
Hey, what's wrong...?
Why're you acting all needy!? Get to your $$リハビリ$$!
Heh... get some rest.
Don't push yourself, all right...!
I'm asking you, don't push yourself...
Overdoing it's poison for your body, you know!?
H-Hey, you okay?
Don't push yourself... If you wreck your body, then it won't do anyone any good!
Good work! I heated up the bath...
It's a hassle, so... wanna just get in together!?
You worked hard today...!
I can't let you show me up!!
